category: client: debrid download manager with a qBittorrent shim

free_tier.stated: A user is free; the README is explicit that the account behind it is not: 'You will need a Premium service at Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize, Torbox or DebridLink, or a HIGHWAY account!'

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable for a user; the provider's cap applies.

retention.stated: not applicable: it manages the provider's torrent and usenet lists and deletes completed items locally after download.

egress.terms: Downloads the files to the local machine ('Download all files from Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize, TorBox or HIGHWAY to your local machine automatically'), so it converts unmetered provider egress into local disk use.

interface_detail: Web UI plus 'a fake qBittorrent API so you can hook up other applications like Sonarr, Radarr or Couchpotato'. Built on .NET 10 and Angular 21; runs as a Windows or Linux service or in Docker.
endpoint: unverified: the project's default web port was not read; the service is configured through appsettings.json
tooling: Docker, Windows service, Linux service; Sonarr, Radarr and Couchpotato as downstream clients.
chaining: The download-to-disk counterpart to Decypharr's stream-in-place: Sonarr grabs through it, it fetches from the provider, unpacks, and leaves a normal file where the *arr stack expects one.

limits.value: none of its own; its polling interval is the provider's problem, and its own issue tracker carries reports of it treating client-side retries as provider 429s

limits_note: The project's issue #952 documents a client-side false 429: 'Evidence this isn't a real RD 429 ... Direct curl from inside the container with the same API key ... all return 200. 30 rapid-fire calls in a row to /torrents also return 200.' A retry layer can invent a throttle that the provider never sent.
binding_note: A pure client: the provider's per-object cap or add floor fails first.

identity_cost.detail: No account with the project; it stores the provider's key.

reliability_note: Its Polly retry pipeline has produced 429 warnings at ~10 ms execution time, which is too fast to be a network round trip; the log says throttled while the provider is healthy.
confidence_note: README read today; the issue tracker entry is third-party observation of a user's behaviour, carried as such.

evidence.proved: the six supported providers (Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize, TorBox, DebridLink, HIGHWAY), usenet support limited to TorBox/Premiumize/HIGHWAY, automatic unpack, and 'Implements a fake qBittorrent API so you can hook up other applications like Sonarr, Radarr or Couchpotato'
a reported case of the client logging 429s while direct calls to /user, /torrents, /torrents/activeCount and /hosts/status returned 200 in the same container

notes: Named separately from Decypharr because the two make different tradeoffs: rdt-client downloads to disk, Decypharr serves in place over NFS/SMB. The client-side false-429 finding belongs for a user, not to Real-Debrid.

extras.providers: real-debrid, alldebrid, premiumize, torbox, debrid-link, high-way
